text: Full stack developer specializing in Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Python ML pipelines. Built autonomous career platform REXION AI with job matching engines, vector search, and automated ATS application runners.

Experienced in building high-throughput queue systems using BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Implemented rate-limiting algorithms, exponential backoff, and jitter routines for LinkedIn API and ATS providers.
Passionate about system architecture, low-latency microservices, responsive React UI design, and developer tools.
